business_scope.primary_industry_name: Maritime Seafarer Staffing and Vessel Crew Management Agency

meta_jurisdiction_context.sovereign_country_en: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (Common Law with Offshore Special Territory status)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Gibraltar-UK Tax Cooperation and Exchange of Information Arrangements
OECD Multilateral Convention on Mutual Administrative Assistance in Tax Matters
Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (New York 1958)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Bermuda: Companies Act 1981 (Exempted Companies), Bermuda AML/ATF Act 2018 and Anti-Money Laundering and Anti-Terrorist Financing (AML/ATF) Regulations 2018, Beneficial Ownership (Exempted Companies) Regulations 2018. Gibraltar: Gibraltar Companies Act 2014, Proceeds of Crime Act 2015, Financial Services (Beneficial Ownership) Regulations 2017, Criminal Finances Act 2018, and the Gibraltar Sanctions Regulations 2020.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Bermuda Ministry of Legal Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Bermuda Ministry of Legal Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Bermuda Ministry of Legal Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (Bermuda Ministry of Legal Affairs)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified identification and address proof of Directors and UBOs
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Original issuing authority (passport office, bank, utility company)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Notarized then consular legalization if origin is non-Hague country; otherwise Hague Apostille

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, beneficial owners, and senior marine recruitment staff against OFAC SDN, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, Gibraltar Sanctions List, UN Security Council Consolidated List (including 1267/1989 Al-Qaida and 2253 ISIL), EU (restrictive measures transposed via Gibraltar Sanctions Regulations), and local law enforcement PEP databases. Negative media and adverse nexus checks required for maritime high-risk ports. Enhanced due diligence triggers if UBO holds public office or is connected to sanctions-hit jurisdictions. Screening results must be documented and retained for at least 5 years per Gibraltar AML/CFT Code.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 (ss. 1–17 on formation, memorandum, articles, registration and certificate of incorporation; s. 23 registered office; ss. 178–183 directors/secretary); Income Tax Act 2010 read with Income Tax (Category 2 Companies) Regulations for exempted/non-resident tax status; Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) Regulations 2013 for crew recruitment licensing; Proceeds of Crime Act 2015 for AML compliance.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Gibraltar Companies House, Registry of Companies, HM Government of Gibraltar, 6 Le Marchant Street, Gibraltar GX11 1AA.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form E-IR (Electronic Incorporation Application) submitted via the COMPANIES HOUSE e-Registry portal, accompanied by the Memorandum and Articles of Association, Statement of Capital, Statement of Proposed Officers and Registered Office Consent Form.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up share capital for a Gibraltar private company limited by shares; incorporators may allot one or more shares at a nominal value (typically GBP 1 each). No escrow or blocked capital account is required for a general trading entity. However, if the company operates as a seafarer recruitment and placement (manning) agency, the Gibraltar Maritime Administration may impose a financial guarantee, professional indemnity insurance or a bank bond as a licensing condition.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the incorporation of the Company under the Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 is hereby ratified and the allotment of shares to the subscribers, as set out in the Statement of Capital, be and is hereby confirmed and accepted. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company be fixed at the address of the licensed registered office service provider and that the registered agent be authorised to file the registered office notification with the Registrar of Companies. RESOLVED FURTHER, that [Name] and [Name] be and are hereby appointed as the first directors and that [Name] be appointed as the first company secretary. RESOLVED FURTHER, that the officers be and are hereby authorised, jointly and severally, to execute all incorporation documents, open corporate bank accounts, and make all necessary regulatory filings to commence the crewing business.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House — Name Reservation Desk (e-Registry portal)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation request through the licensed Gibraltar registered agent or directly via the Companies House e-Registry. The proposed name must end in 'Limited' or 'Ltd' and must not be identical or confusingly similar to any existing registered name. Conduct a trademark and domain availability check. The Registrar issues a Name Clearance Certificate enabling reservation for 28 days.
required_dossiers: Proposed company name (up to three alternatives)
Name clearance application form
Consent of the proposed registered agent
Proof of identity of subscribers and directors (passport, utility bill, bank reference) for AML purposes
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected as confusing or objectionable, file a written appeal with the Registrar within 14 days or resubmit with an alternative name; the reservation fee is credited toward the re-submission.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Gibraltar Corporate Service Provider / notary public acting as agent for the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association (M&A) in accordance with the Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 and the Model Articles for a Private Company Limited by Shares. Execute the M&A by each subscriber in the presence of a witness, and prepare the Statement of Capital, Statement of Proposed Officers, and Registered Office Consent Form signed by the registered agent.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (draft and executed)
Statement of Capital and Initial Shareholdings
Statement of Proposed Officers (Form EO)
Consent to act as director and company secretary signed by each appointee
Registered Office Consent Form (Form RO) from the service provider
AML/KYC pack of each subscriber and beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar queries the M&A (e.g., unlawful object clause or incomplete Statement of Capital), amend by Deed of Amendment and resubmit; no re-filing fee is applied if the correction is made within the 10-day query window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing and Registration at Companies House
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Companies House — Registry Filing Window / e-Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent makes a secure electronic submission (Form E-IR) attaching the executed M&A, Statement of Capital, Statement of Proposed Officers, Registered Office Consent and the prescribed filing fee, authenticated by the agent's digital certificate. The Registrar examines the application for legal conformity and, if satisfied, allocates a company number and issues a Certificate of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Form E-IR (electronic incorporation application)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Statement of Capital
Statement of Proposed Officers
Registered office consent form
Filing fee payment confirmation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the incorporation application is rejected or queried (e.g., inconsistent officer data), file an amended Form E-IR through the agent within five working days; the Registry expedites the corrected filing without re-imposing the full fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Tax Status Election
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registry of Companies and the Gibraltar Income Tax Office (Taxpayer Services)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon registration, the Registrar issues a Certificate of Incorporation bearing the registered company number. Within 30 days, apply to the Gibraltar Income Tax Office for tax classification; for an exempted/non-resident structure, elect Category 2 (non-resident) status under the Income Tax (Category 2 Companies) Regulations, attaching a declaration that the company is controlled and managed outside Gibraltar. The Tax Office issues a Tax Reference Number and, where applicable, a Category 2 Certificate.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation (certified copy)
Category 2 Company election form (Form TAX-C2)
Declaration of non-resident control and management
Details of registered office and agent
Subscriber and director identification documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If Category 2 status is denied for insufficient evidence of non-resident management, supplement the application with board minutes, management contracts and bank statements evidencing offshore control; appeal to the Commissioner of Income Tax within 30 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Corporate Governance and Statutory Registers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registered agent and company secretary under the supervision of the board of directors
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting and pass the first board resolution covering share subscription, registered office adoption and officer appointments. Establish statutory registers (members, directors, secretaries, charges), issue share certificates, adopt the company seal, and approve the bank account mandate. Adopt the AML/CTF compliance manual, board charter and governance procedures required under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2015 and Gibraltar Financial Services Commission guidance.
required_dossiers: First board resolution (minutes)
Register of Members and allotment records
Register of Directors and Secretaries
Share certificates
Company seal (optional)
AML/CTF compliance manual and risk assessment
Register of Charges (if any)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar audits the registers and identifies omissions, file a corrective return with a declaration of accuracy; late filing of the first annual return may attract a penalty of up to GBP 200, avoidable through the agent's compliance calendar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Application for Operating Licence (Seafarer Recruitment / Crew Manning Agency)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Gibraltar Maritime Administration (GMA) — Seafarer Recruitment and Placement Service Licensing Desk, Maritime and Port Services, HM Government of Gibraltar
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Following incorporation and tax registration, submit the application for a Seafarer Recruitment and Placement Service Licence under the Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) Regulations 2013. Demonstrate compliance with ILO Maritime Labour Convention 2006 Title 1.4: no direct or indirect fees charged to seafarers, no blacklisting, adequate grievance procedures, and a financial guarantee sufficient to cover liabilities arising from crew recruitment. Attach crew management contracts, manning operations manual and qualifications of manning officers.
required_dossiers: Application form GMA-MLC-04 (Seafarer Recruitment and Placement Licence)
Certificate of Incorporation and Category 2 status letter
Business plan and crew management operations manual
Financial guarantee / professional indemnity insurance schedule
Draft seafarer recruitment agreement and fee schedule
AML/KYC documentation of directors and beneficial owners
Curriculum vitae of crewing officers in charge
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is refused, the company may make written representations to the GMA Registrar within 21 days and thereafter appeal to the Gibraltar Employment Tribunal under the Employment Act; remedial steps include submitting a compliant fee schedule (prohibiting charges to seafarers) and increasing the security bond.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Gibraltar Maritime Administration (GMA), Maritime and Port Services Division, HM Government of Gibraltar, in coordination with the Gibraltar Employment Tribunal for labour-market licensing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Seafarer Recruitment and Placement Service Licence (Crew Manning Agency Operating Permit) under the Merchant Shipping (Maritime Labour Convention) Regulations 2013 and the Employment Act 1998.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of the Environment, Sustainability, Heritage and Climate Change, HM Government of Gibraltar, together with the Gibraltar Port Authority for maritime environmental matters.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category C — Registration (Exempt from Full EIA): the activity is an office-based, non-industrial service with no construction, manufacturing or cargo-handling operations; a simplified environmental registration must be completed before commencing commercial operations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero industrial effluent discharge from the registered office; office wastewater must discharge into the municipal sewerage network in accordance with the Public Health (Waste) Regulations. Any vessel-support activities (e.g., crew transfer launches) must comply with MARPOL Annexes I–VI as transposed by the Gibraltar Merchant Shipping (Prevention of Pollution) Regulations, and with the Gibraltar Port Waste Management Plan. VOC emissions from marine diesel operations must remain below the odour threshold limits in the Gibraltar Air Quality Regulations (0.00 g/l exceedance in port areas). All general and hazardous waste must be handled by licensed waste contractors under an approved Waste Transfer Note system.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety and Means of Escape Certificate issued by the Gibraltar Fire and Rescue Service following inspection of the registered office; occupational health and safety clearance via a Workplace Safety Audit by the Health and Safety Authority of Gibraltar (Employment Department); structural load and occupancy certification for the office premises from the Building Control Office (Ministry of Transport and Infrastructure). For any crew vessels operated or chartered by the agency, a Gibraltar Certificate of Survey (load line and safety construction) and an ISM/ISPS Document of Compliance are required.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Income Tax Office, HM Government of Gibraltar (Commissioner of Income Tax); online corporate tax portal: https://www.gibraltar.gov.gi/income-tax
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A Bermuda Exempted Company operating from Gibraltar must (1) register as an overseas company with the Gibraltar Registrar of Companies under the Companies Act 2014, filing certified constitutional documents and a registered office address; (2) apply to the Income Tax Office for a Gibraltar Tax Reference Number (TRN) on Form C10, attaching certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles of association, proof of registered office in Gibraltar, details of directors and shareholders, and (if electing non-residence) a declaration of central management and control outside Gibraltar; (3) obtain an EORI number from Gibraltar Customs for any import/export activity; the TRN is issued within 15 working days, and GIT registration is simultaneous for importers.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Gibraltar has no check-the-box election. Tax residence is determined by central management and control. A Bermuda Exempted Company may elect to be treated as non-Gibraltar tax resident by proving its directors and strategic decisions remain in Bermuda, subject to anti-avoidance rules. No hybrid mismatch election is separately available under Gibraltar domestic law, but UK/Gibraltar tie-breaker and UK hybrid mismatch rules may be relevant for funding structures.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: General Indirect Tax (GIT) – no VAT or GST
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: GIP 0 – no turnover threshold; registration mandatory for any person importing commercial goods into Gibraltar or supplying goods/services within scope of GIT. Crew recruitment services supplied to non-resident ship owners are outside the territorial scope of GIT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing, or digital stamping regime exists in Gibraltar. Import GIT is declared through the Gibraltar Customs declaration system (GCS) using EORI and standard EU-compliant Single Administrative Document (SAD) procedures; VAT-accounting is manual; no API-mandated invoicing.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Gibraltar applies a territorial exemption (not zero-rating) to exports of goods and certain offshore services. A crew recruitment agency may treat its seafarer supply services as outside the scope of GIT if the vessel is non-Gibraltar flagged and the ship owner is resident/established outside Gibraltar. Eligibility requires contemporaneous evidence that the benefit of the service is received outside Gibraltar; no GIT is chargeable on the fee or the payroll disbursement.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (only for physical exports of equipment/provisions)
Bill of Lading or Airway Bill (for goods exports)
Inward Remittance Certificate / SWIFT credit confirmation for the foreign-sourced fee
Crewing services agreement with non-resident shipowner
Crew embarkation/disembarkation manifests and seafarer passes
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims for GIT export relief are subject to penalty of up to 150% of the tax evaded, interest, and disqualification of directors; retrospective clawback may extend to six years (no time limit in cases of deliberate wrongdoing). Retention of the aforementioned documentation for at least six years is mandatory to satisfy the Income Tax Office and Customs audit scrutiny.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Gibraltar Financial Services Commission (GFSC) with the Government of Gibraltar Currency Commission for note issuance; Bank of England for sterling zone authority.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: No exchange controls in Gibraltar; both capital and current account fully convertible; no profit remittance restrictions for Bermuda Exempted Companies.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender requirement; 0% mandatory conversion ratio; proceeds may be retained in any foreign currency indefinitely.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (AR01) and Declaration of Solvency
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Companies, Companies House Gibraltar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 42 days after the annual return date (anniversary of initial registration).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalties accrue at GBP 20 (USD 26) per month escalating to GBP 150 (USD 195); continued default triggers administrative strike-off and director disqualification.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Central Beneficial Ownership Register, Gibraltar Companies House
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually on or before the Annual Return due date; within 14 days after any share transfer or change in beneficial ownership.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Criminal offence; fine up to GBP 5,000 (USD 6,450) per officer and up to two years' imprisonment for non-compliance.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporate Tax Return and Financial Statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Commissioner of Income Tax, Income Tax Office, Gibraltar
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within nine months after the close of the accounting period end date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing interest of 0.5% per calendar month and penalties up to 20% of assessed tax; prolonged default may lead to enforcement action against directors.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Crew Recruitment and Placement Licence Annual Renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 31 January each calendar year (annual licence anniversary).
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Operation without renewed licence is an offence; immediate suspension of seafarer recruitment activity and fines up to GBP 10,000 (USD 12,900).

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit unless the company satisfies two of three criteria: annual turnover ≤ GBP 1,000,000 (USD 1,290,000), balance-sheet total ≤ GBP 500,000 (USD 645,000), average employees ≤ 10; any shareholder holding >10% may require an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 and IFRS as adopted in Gibraltar; small exempted companies may apply FRS 102 (UK GAAP). Audited accounts must be annexed to the Annual Return.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The registered agent must file an annual confirmation of the UBO register before the Annual Return is submitted. Any share transfer or change in UBO must be reported to the Central Beneficial Ownership Register within 14 days of the event; the annual confirmation reconciles all such transfers during the year.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% headline corporate income tax in Bermuda for an Exempted Company holding an Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966 (EUTPA) certificate; 12.5% Gibraltar Corporation Tax applies to profits of a Gibraltar branch or managed-and-controlled presence under the Gibraltar Income Tax (Amendment) Act 2011. Sector rates of 14.5% (banking, insurance, utilities) and 19.25% (retail, wholesale, property development) do not apply to ISIC 5222 ship crew recruitment.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Bermuda EUTPA certificate guarantees exemption from all Bermuda income, capital gains and dividend taxes until 31 March 2035; Gibraltar does not confer general tax holidays for crew recruitment agencies; the Gibraltar Patent Box (6% effective rate on qualifying IP income) is irrelevant to the crew agency trade. Real effective saving arises from the 0% Bermuda headline rate on the parent entity and nil Gibraltar withholding taxes.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Gibraltar Corporation Tax Return (Form CT), filed online through the Gibraltar Income Tax Office self-assessment portal. The Bermuda Exempted Company must first register as an oversea company with the Gibraltar Registrar of Companies and obtain a Gibraltar tax reference number for its Gibraltar branch.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, covering the 12-month accounting period selected at registration.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Form CT must be filed no later than 12 months after the end of the accounting period; self-assessed corporation tax is payable in two equal instalments, the first within 6 months of the accounting period end and the balance within 12 months.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, Gibraltar tax reference, Companies Registry CRN, registered office or branch address, and declaration of Bermuda incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident company filing through a Gibraltar branch must disclose the Bermuda incorporation number, the Gibraltar registered branch address, and the name of the branch manager as the statutory filing contact.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: From/to dates of the chargeable accounting period; one Form CT per accounting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the Gibraltar branch accounting period, aligned where possible to the Bermuda group year-end; closure of the period triggers the 12-month filing clock.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Turnover from crew placement, seafarer payroll settlement, mobilization fees, shipowner commissions, and employment recharges.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report only Gibraltar-branch gross receipts. Intra-group recharges from the Bermuda head office must be disclosed in the transfer-pricing schedule attached to the return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Trading profit before capital allowances computed under the Gibraltar Income Tax Act 2010, after deducting crew wages, marine insurance, Gibraltar premises costs, and statutory social insurance contributions.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Restrict deductible overheads to expenses incurred for the Gibraltar branch; Bermuda head-office management charges are deductible only with contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Unrelieved trading losses brought forward and set off against current profits of the same crew-agency trade.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Bermuda head-office losses cannot be surrendered to the Gibraltar branch; no group relief is available without an applicable double tax treaty.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Chargeable income multiplied by the standard 12.5% corporation tax rate, with a computation note showing any allowable deductions or Patent Box deduction claimed.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply only the standard rate applicable to the crew-management trade; do not claim sector-specific rates applicable to banking, retail or development activities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offsets for payments on account (50% due at month 6) and the final balance payable with the return.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Remit instalments from a Gibraltar-designated payroll or operating account; settlements funded directly from Bermuda may be recharacterized as loans or distributions under transfer-pricing rules.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Signature of a director or authorised agent, declaring the return true, complete and compliant with the Gibraltar self-assessment regime.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: At least one Gibraltar-resident director or a licensed Gibraltar agent must sign; digital signatures are accepted only from approved Gibraltar fiduciary providers.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Automatic late-filing penalty of GIP 100 per return, escalating by daily surcharges up to GIP 7,500. Gross-negligence under-declaration attracts 100% of the underpaid tax, statutory interest, criminal fines up to GIP 100,000, and imprisonment up to 3 years for a director who knowingly files a false return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Bermuda Annual Return of an Exempted Company prescribed under the Bermuda Companies Act 1981, including the EUTPA certificate maintenance filing, submitted through the Bermuda Registrar of Companies online registry portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, irrespective of income. This is a registration and Government-fee compliance return; no Bermuda income tax return exists because Bermuda imposes no corporate income tax.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Filing and payment of the Bermuda annual Government fee are due no later than 60 days after the anniversary of the exempted company's incorporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered number, legal name, registered office in Bermuda, and declaration of exempted undertaking status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Bermuda registered agent's office must be stated as the registered address; a Gibraltar branch address cannot substitute for the Bermuda registered office.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: List of directors, secretary and principal representative with an address in Bermuda.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident directors are permitted; at least one natural person must be reachable in Bermuda for service of process and regulatory notices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Reference number and expiry date of the tax protection certificate issued under the Exempted Undertakings Tax Protection Act 1966.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Confirm the certificate remains in force by disclosing any change of tax residence; continued Gibraltar taxation of the branch does not revoke Bermuda tax protection unless the entity becomes Bermuda-tax-resident.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Ultimate beneficial owner declaration under the Bermuda Beneficial Ownership Act 2017.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must be fully identified; omissions expose the entity to freezing orders and loss of the exempted status.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Persistent non-filing attracts a civil penalty of BMD 200 plus daily escalating fines, forfeiture of the EUTPA protection, and administrative striking-off of the Bermuda entity with resulting asset forfeiture and director disqualification.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% in Bermuda and 0% in Gibraltar. A Bermuda Exempted Company may distribute dividends to non-resident shareholders free of Bermuda withholding tax, and the Gibraltar branch remittance to the Bermuda parent is likewise subject to no Gibraltar dividend withholding tax, provided dividends are declared from after-tax Gibraltar profits and documented in board minutes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Gibraltar and Bermuda have no double tax agreement, so no treaty rate is available for the Bermuda parent. Where the ultimate corporate shareholder is UK-resident, the UK–Gibraltar Double Taxation Agreement may be invoked by submitting an application to the Gibraltar Commissioner of Income Tax using the designated TRC application form, together with a UK HMRC Certificate of Residence, at least 30 days before the dividend record date. The protocol requires: (1) proof of Gibraltar tax residence of the paying branch, (2) the UK residency certificate, (3) a Form CT dividend schedule, and (4) beneficial ownership declarations. Because Gibraltar imposes nil withholding, the TRC mainly serves to evidence residence and prevent UK attribution challenges.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% statutory withholding in Bermuda and 0% in Gibraltar on cross-border royalties and debt interest. No treaty relief is necessary for such payments. However, royalties paid by the Gibraltar arm to the Bermuda parent for brands, software or crew-management systems are deductible only to the extent they satisfy the arm's length benefit test; excess royalties are disallowed and recharacterized as distributions subject to 12.5% Gibraltar corporation tax plus late-payment interest.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: GIP 0.00. Contemporaneous transfer-pricing documentation, including a Local File and, where the MNE group exceeds EUR 750 million consolidated revenue, a Gibraltar Country-by-Country Report notification, is mandatory for every Gibraltar tax-resident entity engaged in controlled transactions. For an ISIC 5222 crew-management agency, intra-group payroll recharges, crew-fee settlements, and management charges above GIP 500,000 annually must be supported by an OECD-compliant transfer-pricing file.
approved_arm_length_methodologies: CUP (Comparable Uncontrolled Price) – benchmark for shipowner crew-fee contracts and commission rates
Resale Price Method – for payroll pass-through and travel settlement activities
Cost Plus Method – for employment and crew-outsourcing services where the agency performs routine cost-based functions
TNMM (Transactional Net Margin Method) – for commission-based crewing agencies using full-cost plus 5%-10% net margin
Profit Split Method – for integrated group ventures where the Gibraltar branch and Bermuda parent jointly bear global crew-sourcing risk
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable in both layers. Bermuda: the Exempted Company must satisfy the Economic Substance (International Tax Compliance) Act 2018 unless it is tax-resident in Gibraltar, in which case annual filing relief is available. Gibraltar: the Income Tax Act (Economic Substance) Guidelines treat crew recruitment and vessel crew administration as a shipping-support relevant activity, requiring the Gibraltar operation to maintain a licensed office, employ maritime staffing professionals such as marine superintendents, crewing officers and payroll officers, and perform the core income-generating activities of sourcing, vetting, contracting, dispatch and payroll disbursement in Gibraltar. A letterbox or bare-invoice operation fails both regimes.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Corporate tax evasion on Gibraltar branch profits
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate under-declaration of crew-agency commissions, payroll margins, or mobilization fees in the Gibraltar Form CT, or operating a secondary shadow payroll for cash-paid seafarers outside the accounting ledger.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the Gibraltar Income Tax Act 2010: penalty up to 100% of the tax shortfall, daily default surcharges, statutory interest, criminal fines up to GIP 100,000 per return, and forfeiture of the aircraft? No, forfeiture of the vessels involved in the payroll scheme.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: A director who knowingly signs a false return or omits a material revenue line is personally liable for the civil penalty, faces up to 3 years imprisonment, and may be subjected to a travel ban and disqualification from acting as a Gibraltar company director.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Bermuda and Gibraltar economic substance failure (shell company abuse)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the Bermuda Exempted Company with only a registered agent in Bermuda and a billing address in Gibraltar while crew recruitment and payroll management are physically directed from outside both territories, and failing to appoint local maritime managers or demonstrate operational expenditure.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Gibraltar ESR non-compliance: financial penalties up to GIP 100,000, compulsory branch strike-off and dissolution; Bermuda ESR penalties up to BMD 250,000 and rescission of the EUTPA tax protection, converting the entity into a taxable Bermuda undertaking.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally liable for unpaid penalties, disqualified for up to 10 years by the Gibraltar Financial Services Commission, and any nominee director who falsely certifies economic substance commits an offence under the Gibraltar Companies Act 2014 and Bermuda perjury rules.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Transfer pricing manipulation on crew-payroll recharges
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Overbilling shipowners through the Bermuda parent by adding artificial margins to crew salaries, mobilization costs, or P&I insurance recharges, or undercharging the Gibraltar branch for management services to shift taxable profit from the 12.5% Gibraltar base to the zero-tax Bermuda entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The Gibraltar Commissioner will adjust the controlled pricing to the arm's length margin under the transfer-pricing provisions, assess additional 12.5% corporation tax with interest, and levy misdeclaration penalties up to 100% of the additional tax; no compensating credit is available in Bermuda.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil restitution for the shortfall lies against the signatory director under the trading-misfeasance rules of the Gibraltar Companies Act 2014; directors of the Bermuda parent are jointly and severally liable if they received the repatriated margin as dividends with knowledge of the artificial markup, and are exposed to asset-freezing orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML and maritime payroll money laundering
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the multi-currency SWIFT payroll rails to channel undisclosed cash to seafarers in sanctioned jurisdictions, maintaining nominee-laden crew lists, or settling no-show personnel to generate offshore cash pools for third parties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Seizure and confiscation of funds under the Gibraltar Proceeds of Crime Act 2015, fines against the licensed crew agency up to GIP 1,000,000 per violation, and revocation of the MLC crewing licence held with the Gibraltar Maritime Administration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the compliance officer are individually indictable for money laundering, carrying up to 14 years imprisonment, personal confiscation orders, travel bans affecting maritime crew clearance, and disqualification from financial services in Gibraltar and Bermuda.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Employer compliance fraud (social insurance and payroll obligations)
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misclassifying seafarers as non-Gibraltar or dispatched abroad to avoid Gibraltar social insurance contributions, failing to register the crew agency as an employer with the Gibraltar authorities, or routing net pay through the Bermuda entity without Gibraltar payroll withholding records.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Recovery of all unpaid social insurance contributions, penalties of 20%–30% of the arrears, daily criminal fines, and repeated breaches resulting in revocation of the employment agency licence and administrative dissolution of the Gibraltar branch.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Under the Gibraltar social security and contributions legislation, the responsible director and payroll manager are personally liable for unpaid contributions; courts may impose travel bans pending settlement and director disqualification for up to 10 years.
